name: AniWorld Downloader
overview: Search for and download anime, series and movies through AniWorld Downloader
description: Adds an AniWorld page to the Jellyfin web client and the official Android and iOS apps. It searches AniWorld Downloader, queues downloads into your libraries and can keep series up to date with Auto-Sync.

versions.changelog:
- Search: filter results by type, site and "only titles in my library" without searching again; the filters stay when you go back from a title
- Grid or list: switch search results and the start page between posters and a compact list; the choice is remembered on each device
- Start page as a list: the first 6 titles of each list, with Show all for the rest

- Auto-Sync page for admins: every tracked series with its schedule, last check and recent downloads; change, check now or stop syncing a series
- The plugin page uses Jellyfin's own components, so it follows the theme (SleekFin included)
- Compact title page: poster, name, genres, overview; episodes Jellyfin already has count as in your library
- Queue: speed, time left, Auto-Sync or manual, who started it (admins), failed episodes with their errors, and Show more
- Queue actions: try again, move up or down, remove; admins can clear all finished downloads
- Fixed: a running download showed the wrong episode number and too little progress
- On phones, the download bar stays above a theme's bottom bar (SleekFin)

- base dev build versions on the newest release, not build.yaml
- log the queue page's failed polls quietly
- build every branch push as a dev version and list it in a dev manifest
- scan the library after downloads, keep download owners across restarts, and log outages once
- note that queue items carry no target folder
- add a to-do list of plugin ideas

- tag and release a new version when it reaches main
- link the detail page to the title's own site

Search results appear site by site as each site answers. Before searching, the page shows new and popular anime, series and movies. Jellyfin's own series page gets a button to download the missing episodes, and you get a message in Jellyfin when a download is done.
Search results can be filtered to what is already in your library, and the Auto-Sync settings on a title fit on a phone.
First release: search anime, series and movies on every site from inside Jellyfin, download episodes, see what is already in your library, keep series up to date with Auto-Sync and follow the queue.
